subject: Pack divider structs
perf_evidence: Commit explicitly packs divider structs to reduce storage and improve memory-intensive workloads.
change_summary: Applies one-byte packing to public divider structs, changing their size and alignment.

units.name: public sizeof(libdivide_u32_t)
units.evidence: Alive2 rejects both directions: sizeof returns 8 before and 5 after the packing change, with a concrete value-mismatch witness.

units.name: generated signed-32, signed-64 and unsigned-64 division results
units.evidence: The three named generated-division targets pass Alive2 in both directions; unsigned-32 generation remains inconclusive in this run.

units.name: generated unsigned-32 division result
units.evidence: The target_u32_api proof timed out in both directions in the retained all-target run.

notes: The semantic difference is the documented public memory layout, not a proved division-result change. The raw do_ptr comparisons use different struct pointer types and are not promoted to an API verdict. Other packed struct types and the pending long unsigned-32 proof are not needed to establish this counterexample. The wrapper disables unchanged x86 inline assembly on both sides.
